response.original_title: 【Easy™-Guide】 How do I add a passenger on a Viking Cruise?
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing Viking Cruise booking, you must call Viking Customer Support directly at +1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada) or +44-289-708-0062 (UK) or contact your travel advisor, as this cannot be done online or through the mobile app  Important Details to Know  Cabin and Ship Capacity: Adding a guest depends on whether your current stateroom has available extra bed or double-occupancy space, as well as the ship's overall lifeboat and safety capacity limits.  Re-pricing: The booking will be subject to re-pricing at current rates for the additional passenger, including applicable taxes, port charges, and fees.  Required Information: Be prepared to provide the new passenger's full legal name (matching their ID/passport), date of birth, gender, and citizenship/nationality details.
